item.title: News briefs
item.description: Editor’s note: Organizations in The Register-Herald’s coverage area are encouraged to submit scheduled events and news for the weekly News Briefs. Items can be emailed to emowen@aimmediamidwest.com. Deadline for inclusion in the Wednesday edition is 5 p.m. the Friday prior; deadline for inclusion in the Saturday edition is 5 p.m. the Wednesday prior. Items are published as space allows until the date of events has passed, or for ongoing listings, until removal is requested. The post News briefs

item.title: Brookvile police plan CSI summer camp
item.description: BROOKVILLE — Police Chief Doug Jerome informed council his department is planning its first-ever Crime Scene Investigation (CSI) summer camp. The post Brookvile police plan CSI summer camp appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Eaton BOE reviews five-year financial forecast
item.description: EATON — Eaton Community Schools Treasurer Rachel Tait presented the district’s five-year financial forecast during the ECS Board of Education meeting held Monday, Feb. 9, outlining projected operating deficits and the potential impact of recent state legislation on future revenues. The post Eaton BOE reviews five-year financial forecast appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Preble first half mobile home taxes now payable
item.description: EATON — Preble County Treasurer Shannon Chappel announced that payment for the first half of 2026 mobile home taxes can now be made. When submitting tax payments, taxpayers are required to return the treasurer’s stub with their check. Questions regarding tax bills may be directed to the Preble County Treasurer’s Office. The post Preble first half mobile home taxes now payable appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.description: BROOKVILLE — It’s that time of year when many high school girls start thinking dresses for prom or even homecoming for next year. The post Purchase a dress and fight cancer appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Ohio farmers need lawmakers to stand with us
item.description: On Wednesday, Feb. 11, I traveled to the Ohio Statehouse to advocate on behalf of Ohio soybean growers during the Ohio Soybean Association’s Legislative Day — not as a lobbyist, but as a farmer. The post Ohio farmers need lawmakers to stand with us appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Brabant sentenced in machete killing
item.description: CAMDEN — A Camden man has been sentenced to 15 years to life prison following the death of a Middletown woman in what officials described as a case of mistaken identity. The post Brabant sentenced in machete killing appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: TCN kindergarten registration begins March 2
item.description: LEWISBURG — Tri-County North Local Schools will be holding online kindergarten registration for the 2026-2027 school year Monday, March 2, through Friday, March 13. The post TCN kindergarten registration begins March 2 appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Preble County ESC BAC earns Four-Star Business Advisory Council designation for 2026
item.description: EATON — The Preble County Educational Service Center has been recognized as one of Ohio’s top-performing Business Advisory Councils, earning a Four-Star designation as part of the state’s 2026 Business-Education Leader Awards for Excellent Business Advisory Councils. The post Preble County ESC BAC earns Four-Star Business Advisory Council designation for 2026 appeared first on The Register Herald.
